title: Import or export inventory
summary: Bring items in from a spreadsheet, or export the current list.

steps.text: On {inv}, use {exp} to download the current list, or {imp} to start an import.
On {title}, use {dl} to get a blank spreadsheet in the expected format, then upload your file and map its columns.
You can also give the assistant a spreadsheet to import: it previews the rows and shows the import as a card that runs only when you confirm. It can also export your items for you.
